project.name: The Secret Space
project.goal: Show how The Secret Space helps couples keep their relationship private, connected, and emotionally present with secure mobile features powered by a real backend.
target_audience: couples who want a private space just for them
people who value privacy, encryption, and secure sharing

visual_style: cinematic close-ups of the phone in hand
soft glow, rose-gold accents, dark elegant backgrounds
smooth motion with gentle parallax and screen zooms

music_direction.notes: Use subtle pulse and a hopeful lift near the end. Keep the mix understated so the UI and voiceover stay clear.

creative_direction.narration_style: Calm, intimate, confident voiceover. Avoid corporate language.

core_message: A private relationship space with encrypted chat, secure memories, and real-time connection, powered by a reliable backend.

scene_plan.visual: Dark background. Phone lights up with the Secret Space brand mark and a subtle glowing heart motif.
scene_plan.voiceover: Some connections deserve a space that feels private, calm, and truly yours.
scene_plan.camera: Slow push-in on the phone, soft reflection, cinematic focus pull.

scene_plan.visual: Onboarding flow with couple code, OTP, and face enrollment. Show fast, secure setup on mobile.
scene_plan.voiceover: Get started with secure onboarding, couple code pairing, and face or password verification.
scene_plan.camera: Screen capture with smooth zooms and UI highlight pulses.

scene_plan.visual: Encrypted chat screen with typing presence, reactions, voice notes, and shared media in the conversation.
scene_plan.voiceover: Message each other in real time with end-to-end encryption, reactions, voice notes, and media sharing.
scene_plan.camera: Fast but elegant UI cuts between chat states and a subtle lock animation.

scene_plan.visual: Vault unlock screen, biometric prompt, then a grid of private photos and videos inside the vault.
scene_plan.voiceover: Keep photos and videos in a secure vault that unlocks with biometrics and protects what matters most.
scene_plan.camera: Transition from fingerprint/face unlock to the vault grid with a glow sweep.

scene_plan.visual: Shared diary feed and diary detail screens with image/video entries and soft reactions.
scene_plan.voiceover: Capture the little things together in a shared diary, from daily thoughts to photo and video memories.
scene_plan.camera: Vertical scroll through diary cards, then a close-up on a detail view.

scene_plan.visual: Coupons and LoveBot screens: a surprise coupon, a daily love note, a mood check-in card, and a notification arriving on the phone.
scene_plan.voiceover: Send favors, track mood, and let LoveBot deliver a reason to smile when life gets busy.
scene_plan.camera: Quick montage with notification pop, coupon card flip, and gentle heart animation.

scene_plan.visual: Backend-inspired motion graphic: encrypted data lines, cloud storage, sync pulses, and push notification icons connecting back to the phone.
scene_plan.voiceover: Behind the scenes, secure APIs, real-time sync, and trusted storage keep everything fast and reliable.
scene_plan.camera: Abstract network animation that resolves back into the phone UI.

scene_plan.visual: End card with logo, glowing heart mark, app name, and a minimal call to action.
scene_plan.on_screen_text: The Secret Space. Keep it just between you.
scene_plan.voiceover: The Secret Space. A private world built for two.
scene_plan.camera: Fade out on the logo with a soft rose-gold glow.

voiceover_script: Some connections deserve a space that feels private, calm, and truly yours.
Get started with secure onboarding, couple code pairing, and face or password verification.
Message each other in real time with end-to-end encryption, reactions, voice notes, and media sharing.
Keep photos and videos in a secure vault that unlocks with biometrics and protects what matters most.
Capture the little things together in a shared diary, from daily thoughts to photo and video memories.
Send favors, track mood, and let LoveBot deliver a reason to smile when life gets busy.
Behind the scenes, secure APIs, real-time sync, and trusted storage keep everything fast and reliable.
The Secret Space. A private world built for two.
on_screen_text_sequence: The Secret Space. Keep it just between you.

ui_capture_requirements: Record the mobile app in portrait orientation.
Use clean demo data for chat, diary, vault, coupons, mood, and LoveBot.
Show real transitions between screens instead of static screenshots.
Include one biometric unlock moment and one push notification moment.
motion_rules: Use subtle scale and opacity transitions.
Keep all motion smooth and premium.
Avoid noisy glitch effects or overly loud transitions.
Let the UI breathe with short pauses between feature highlights.
text_rules: Keep text short and easy to read on mobile.
Do not mention the frontend/web product.
Do not overload the ad with technical jargon.
